_comment: The document formats Icon actually bills through, and so the formats the test set must cover (docs/roadmap.md PR 12). Icon usually will not know the product's name - every client and consultant may use a different system - so a format is named for its shape. Adding one here without adding a case fails the coverage test rather than being noticed after the first live cycle. The cases themselves carry invented names throughout (tests/evals/build_real_format_cases.py).
